question: Which of the following singer was awarded Padma Bhushan in 2023 for her contribution to film playback singing in 19 languages?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Vani Jairam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vani Jairam** is recognized for her immense contribution to Indian playback singing.
 
• She has sung in **19 languages**, which includes but is not limited to Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, and Marathi.
 
• In 2023, Vani Jairam was awarded the Padma Bhushan, one of India's highest civilian honors, acknowledging her significant impact on the field of music.
 
• Her career spans several decades, starting from the 1970s, and she continues to be an influential figure in the music industry.
 
• Vani Jairam is known for her versatility and the emotional depth she brings to her songs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Sulochana Chavan**__

 __
 
• Sulochana Chavan is a veteran singer known for her contributions to Marathi lavani music.
 
• She was honored with the Padma Shri in 2022 for her contributions to regional music.
 
 
 
• **KS Chithra**__
 __
 
• KS Chithra is a prominent playback singer who has sung in multiple Indian languages, including Malayalam, Tamil, Telugu, and Kannada.
 
• She has won numerous awards, including the Padma Bhushan in 2021 for her contributions to Indian music.
 
 
 
• **DK. Pattammal**__
 
 
• DK Pattammal was an esteemed Carnatic musician known for her classical compositions and performances.
 
• She has been acknowledged with several awards, including the Padma Vibhushan, India's second-highest civilian award.
